_instructions: Where the execution mode's guidance goes. placement: "history" puts the full guidance in set_execution_mode results in the conversation history and nothing in each step's guidance message; "both" (default) does the same plus the one-line status_line in each step's guidance message; "per_step" puts the full guidance in each step's guidance message and set_execution_mode results carry only the mode and revision. status_line may use {label}.
status_line: Execution mode: {label}. Its full guidance is in the latest set_execution_mode result.
